content.short: Coin Wallet is an open source self custody wallet for buying, sending, swapping, and storing crypto on web, mobile, and desktop.
content.description: Coin Wallet is a self custody wallet from Coin.Space that supports web, desktop, and mobile access for managing crypto in one place. Its official feature set centers on client side encryption, local key storage, BIP39 protection, PIN or biometric login, and optional Tor or VPN routing for added privacy. The wallet supports buying, selling, swapping, sending, and receiving assets across many networks, including Toncoin and jettons on TON, while keeping the product open source and focused on user controlled keys.
content.meta: Coin Wallet is an open source self custody wallet for buying, swapping, and storing crypto on web, mobile, desktop, and TON apps.
